subject: PO policy carveout & evidence roadmap for Sunpeak onboarding
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir@sunpeak.io>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: procureops@sunpeak.io
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor setup — invoice-only request + required evidence

Vanessa,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. We are ready to start a short pilot (60 days) but our procurement team requires one clarification before vendor setup: Sunpeak prefers an invoice-only flow for trials under $10k — no PO — provided vendors can supply specific evidence (insurance, SOC2 excerpt, data handling attestation and an acceptable W-9).

Can Redwood accept onboarding without a PO for this pilot if we provide the evidence bundle? If not, what are the minimal exceptions your finance team will accept? We need to close this flow by EOD Friday to meet our internal kickoff.

Attachments: Sunpeak_SOW_draft.pdf (reference)

Appreciate a short summary of next steps and a single-point contact for procurement.

—Samir
Samir Gupta
Lead, Strategic Procurement
Sunpeak Analytics
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Samir Gupta <samir@sunpeak.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Vendor setup — invoice-only request + required evidence

Samir — thanks, and welcome aboard. Short answer: we can support an invoice-only pilot under $10k with a Procurement Exception, provided we collect the evidence package you listed and sign a short intake addendum.

High level plan (next 48 hours):
- Sunpeak submits the evidence bundle to the shared Drive link (insurance cert, SOC2 excerpt, data handling attestation, W-9).
- Redwood Finance (Laura) reviews evidence and issues a written Procurement Exception approval if greenlit.
- Legal will counter-sign the intake addendum (two-paragraph addendum limiting liability and clarifying billing cadence).
- On approval, vendor record created and billing set to invoice-only for the pilot period.

I attached our internal evidence checklist (po-exception-evidence-checklist.xlsx) and a blank vendor intake form (sunpeak_vendor_form.pdf) — please upload completed items to the Drive folder linked below. 

We’ll aim for a single approval email from Finance so your team has something to attach to their kickoff packet. Looping in Laura and Ben to expedite.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: po-exception-evidence-checklist.xlsx, sunpeak_vendor_form.pdf
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bSunpeakOnboard
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 13:28:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Vendor setup — invoice-only request + required evidence

Thanks Vanessa — I reviewed Samir’s ask and the checklist. Quick notes from Finance: 

1) We can approve invoice-only for pilots under $10k if:
   - The evidence checklist is complete,
   - There is a named internal sponsor (account owner on the pilot), and
   - Legal signs the intake addendum with the 60-day pilot term.

2) Evidence tolerances (where exceptions are permitted):
   - SOC2: excerpt acceptable if it includes security scope and control owner; full report preferred for anything over $25k.
   - Insurance: certificate of general liability + cyber endorsement for at least $1M combined limit; we can accept broker-confirmation pending certificate upload within 3 business days.
   - Data handling attestation: must state that customer data is not used to train public models and retention windows.

3) Workflow & timeline:
   - If Sunpeak uploads everything by EOD Wednesday, Finance will turn around a formal Procurement Exception approval by Thursday COB.
   - Legal (Ben) will prepare the intake addendum draft same day and aim for signature within 24–48 hours.

Laura (Finance) will send the approval memo to Samir and cc Vanessa so they have an auditable record. I’ll start a HubSpot note (HS-12345) and attach the Drive folder.

Laura Bennett
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Samir Gupta <samir@sunpeak.io>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Vendor setup — invoice-only request + required evidence

Samir — looping in Legal as promised. Vanessa, Laura: I’ll draft a concise intake addendum that limits scope to the 60-day pilot, states the invoice-only billing cadence, and includes the evidence-acknowledgment clause from Finance. I’ll send a draft to Samir for redline by Monday morning.

Couple quick items for Sunpeak to confirm in the form:
- Billing contact name + billing email (where the invoice should be sent)
- Primary technical contact for the pilot (for environment access and onboarding)

Samir — if you can drop those two details into the vendor form on Drive I’ll include them in the addendum. If anything is missing, we’ll include a conditional approval that requires final certificate uploads within 3 business days of pilot start.

Ben Carter
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Procurement
ben@redwood.com
